infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Bankstown and Lidcombe
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 7 and Sunday 8 November
  • Buses replace trains between Bankstown and Lidcombe.
  • Buses also replace T3 Liverpool & Inner West Line trains between Liverpool and Lidcombe.
  • Change at:
    - Lidcombe for trains towards the City or T1 Western Line stations
    - Regents Park for buses towards Liverpool
    - Bankstown for metro services

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
 
Bus routes
8T6    Bankstown, all stations to Lidcombe and return
8AT6  Bankstown, express to Lidcombe and return
9T3    Liverpool, all stations to Lidcombe and return
19T3  Cabramatta, express to Lidcombe and return
 
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Changes to school bus services in Lithgow
infoLinks.content:
There are timetable changes to school transport services impacted by the closure of the Great Western Highway at Victoria Pass. Changes should reduce travel time for the majority of students.  
  • Some students may have different times for their bus service or a slightly longer walk to their bus stop. 
  • Some students attending Blue Mountains Grammar will travel in the mornings by bus from Hartley Vale to Lithgow train station and transfer to a train to Wentworth Falls. 
  • Some students attending Blue Mountains Grammar will travel in the mornings by train from Blackheath station to Wentworth Falls station.  
  • Journey times are subject to traffic volumes. 
  • Check the Trip Planner for the latest.

    - Leppington and Central, platforms 1-14 via Sydenham
    - Revesby and Central via the Airport
  • T4 Eastern Suburbs & Illawarra Line trains make extra stops at St Peters and Erskineville.
  • You may need to change trains to continue your journey.

  • From 9.40pm Saturday to 3am Sunday, buses also replace trains between Leppington and East Hills.
  • Trains run between East Hills and Central via the Airport.
Trackwork on the City Circle may also affect how you travel
  • Trains do not run around the City Circle but continue to run between Central and Wynyard.
  • For travel to Circular Quay, St James or Museum use light rail, local buses or walk.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
 
Bus routes
11T8    Campbelltown, Minto, Ingleburn, Glenfield and return
79T2    Macarthur, all stations to Fairfield and return
80T2    Liverpool, all stations to Fairfield and return 9.40pm Saturday to 3am Sunday
22T2    Leppington, all stations to East Hills and return
74T8    Macarthur, all stations to Glenfield, then express to East Hills and return
 
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Change to Rutherford Technology High School bus services and pass requirements from 26 May
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 26 May, students travelling in the morning from the Rutherford and Aberglasslyn areas to Rutherford Technology High School are to use the 2712 service (operated by CDC NSW), instead of the S520 service (operated by Grace Coaches).

What's changing:
  • There is a slight timetable difference between the S520 and 2712, so please check TripPlanner to plan your journey.
  • Students on the 2712 service by CDC NSW will need an Opal card. If you don’t already have one, find out more about how to apply for a pass.
  • The 2712 will drop students closer to Rutherford Technology High School than the S520 previously did – arriving at Alexandra Ave after Weblands St (232097) at 08:32.
  • Afternoon travel is not affected.

  • Plan your trip and check timetables before you travel.

infoLinks.urlText: School bus service changes for Medowie and surrounds
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 16 March, afternoon services have been adjusted to alleviate crowding on route S852 Medowie Christian School to Stroud, operated by Port Stephens Coaches.
Changes to route 1621 and 1463 services will affect Medowie Christian School and Irrawang High School. Plan your trip to view all stops and real-time up to date information.
 
Changes:

  • 1463 will now service the Bower Estate before continuing along The Bucketts Way to Booral Public School. Timings below.
Operating on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday:
  • Route 1621
    • Irrawang High School 15:20
    • Medowie Christian School 15:36
    • Kindlebark Oval 16:01
    • Carolina Rd at Royal Ave 16:08

  • Route 1463
    • Irrawang High School 15:17
    • Medowie Christian School 15:36
    • Booral Public School 16:11
Operating on Wednesday:

    • Irrawang High School 14:45
    • Medowie Christian School 15:15
    • Kindlebark Oval 15:33

infoLinks.urlText: T1 North Shore Line: Buses replace trains between Berowra and Hornsby
infoLinks.content:
Monday 9 and Wednesday 11 November
  • Nightly from 9.40pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Berowra and Hornsby.
  • Trains run between Hornsby and the City, some to a changed timetable.
  • Buses also replace T9 Northern Line trains between Hornsby and Epping, and Central Coast & Newcastle Line trains between Gosford and Hornsby.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
 
Bus routes
1CN   Gosford, express to Berowra, Hornsby and return
2CN   Woy Woy, all stations to Point Clare, express to Berowra, all stations to Hornsby and return
 
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Changes to school bus services impacted by Waterfall Way closure
infoLinks.content:
Some school buses are not running due to the closure of Waterfall Way west of Bellingen due to a landslip.  
As an interim solution for school students in the Dorrigo and Bellingen area, a fleet of minibuses will operate school services via the detour on Summervilles Road.
From Monday 9 February, a phased approach has commenced for school bus services. Families should stay abreast of communication being distributed via their schools.
Sign up for SMS updates about interim bus service cancellations
Inclement weather and road conditions have the potential to prevent interim bus movements on the detour route and cancel services.
Transport has set up an SMS service to notify families of cancellations of services. Opt in to receive SMS via this link.
Routes affected:
  • S110
  • S125
  • S126
  • S127
  • S887

  • Plan your trip for real time, up to date information.
Changes to route 600:
  • New timetable.
  • Minor retiming of services across the week, including for Tweed Valley Community Care. 
See the news article for more information.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace Inner West trains between Strathfield and Central. Trains run to a changed stopping pattern
infoLinks.content:
Monday 2 and Tuesday 3 November
  • Nightly from 9.20pm to 1.30am, buses replace Inner West trains between Strathfield and Central. Express trains continue to run.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Leppington and Olympic Park. Change trains at Lidcombe to continue your journey.
  • T1 Western Line trains make extra stops at Flemington, Homebush and Burwood. Some T9 Northern Line trains make extra stops at Croydon and Ashfield.
Trackwork on the City Circle may also affect how you travel
  • Trains do not run on the City Circle, or between Central and Wynyard.
  • For travel in the City use T4 Eastern Suburbs Line trains, metro, light rail, local buses or walk.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
44T2   Strathfield, all stations to Stanmore, Central and return
47T2   Strathfield, all stations to Central and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

  • From 10.30am until 10pm, route 410 bus services will divert and miss stops due to road closures in place for the Majors Bay Road Halloween Festival.
  • Services will divert around Majors Bay Road Road southbound and travel between Brewer St and Gallipoli Street.
  • Route 410 services travelling towards Hurstville operate as normal then to Wellbank St, Flavelle St, Patterson St, Crane St and set down/pick up from the temporary bus stop at Rothwell Park (Stop ID: 2137190)
  • Route 410 buses to Macquarie Park will operate as normal.
  • Check signs at stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time.
Missed and alternative stops:
  • Majors Bay Rd at Gallipoli St (213780) - Alternative stop Rothwell Park, Crane St (2137190)
  • Rothwell Park, Majors Bay Rd (213781) – Alternative stop Rothwell Park, Crane St (2137190)
  • Concord Shops, Wellbank St (2137130) – Alternative stop at Concord Library, Wellbank St (2137117)
subtitle: Concord bus diversions for the Majors Bay Road Halloween Festival

infoLinks.urlText: Tweed bus changes from Monday 29 June
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 29 June, we'll be making some changes to bus services in the Tweed. 
  • These improvements will support better access to Tweed Valley Hospital, improve cross-border connectivity at Tweed Mall and provide bus services for new housing growth in Kings Forest.
  • Plan your trip for real time, up to date information.
Changes to route 605:
  • New timetable and route path change.
  • Doubling of service frequency from every 2 hours to every hour, and an additional 111 services per week.
  • 605 services will no longer travel via Keith Compton Drive and will instead stay on Wharf Street. Keith Compton Drive area will instead be serviced by route 606 services. Route 606 will service Florence Street, Powell Street, Solander Street, Banks Avenue, Keith Compton Drive and Brett Street. Alternatively passengers have the option to walk to Wharf Street to access more frequent bus services, including route 605. 
See the news article for more information.

infoLinks.urlText: New school bus services for students from Calderwood and surrounds
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 20 April, three new school routes will be introduced to serve the Calderwood catchment and surrounds.

New routes:
  • S269 – Calderwood to St Josephs HS
  • S270 – Calderwood to Albion Park HS
  • S271 – Calderwood to Shellharbour Anglican College
These routes will be operated by Premier Illawarra and will service St Joseph’s Catholic High School, Albion Park High School and Shellharbour Anglican College.
 
Morning AM services
  • S269 – Bus will commence on Escarpment Drive at 07:38 and arrive at St
    Joseph’s at 07:48.
  • S270 – Bus will commence on Escarpment Drive at 07:58 and arrive
    at Albion Park HS at 08:09.
  • S271 – Bus will commence on Escarpment Drive at 08:20 and arrive at
    Shellharbour Anglican College at 08:50.
Afternoon PM services
  • S270 – Bus will depart Albion Park HS at 14:40 arriving at Escarpment
    Drive at 14:50.
  • S269 – Bus will depart St Joseph’s HS at 15:00 arriving at Escarpment
    Drive at 15:13.
  • S271 – Bus will depart Shellharbour Anglican College at 15:40 arriving at
    Escarpment Drive at 16:17.
Use the Trip Planner to plan your new trip.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Port Kembla and Wollongong
infoLinks.content:
Thursday 5 November
  • From 9.20am to 2.10pm, buses replace trains between Port Kembla and Wollongong.
  • Buses towards Wollongong may leave stations up to 15 minutes earlier than the normal train timetable.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
 
Bus route
27SC   Port Kembla, all stations to Wollongong and return
 
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Extra weekly services and bus service changes for Northern Illawarra from 3 August

The new and improved bus timetable changes will increase travel options with more services across the week, especially weekday peaks, evenings and weekends.
 
Operated by Dion’s Bus Services, passengers and students can plan the new journey on Trip Planner. View the news article for more information.

  • 90 Austinmer to Wollongong
  • 91 Austinmer, Bulli, Corrimal to University of Wollongong
  • 92 East Bulli, East Woonona, Corrimal
  • 93 East Bulli, East Woonona to University of Wollongong

New route
  • S392 Smith’s Hill High School to Bulli via Corrimal
Withdrawl of route
  • S406 Keira High to Austinmer Station
  • S412 North Wollongong to Woonona High
  • S413 Woonona to Smith’s Hill High
  • S414 Bulli to St Mary Star of the Sea College
  • S420 Austinmer to Woonona High School

  • S402 Austinmer Station to St Mary’s
  • S419 Bulli to Edmund Rice College via Bulli Beach and Woonona
Timetable change

infoLinks.urlText: Tweed bus changes from Monday 29 June
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 29 June, we'll be making some changes to bus services in the Tweed. 
  • These improvements will support better access to Tweed Valley Hospital, improve cross-border connectivity at Tweed Mall and provide bus services for new housing growth in Kings Forest.
  • Plan your trip for real time, up to date information.
Changes to route 601:
  • New timetable and minor route path change.
  • 8 additional services per week, including additional weekday evening services to better suit shift times at Tweed Valley Hospital.
  • Extended from Tweed Valley Hospital to Kings Forest. 
  • Kings Forest residents have a new way to access TAFE NSW Kingscliff campus.
  • A change in Kingscliff town will see route 601 service Sutherland Street.
Every second route 601 service will terminate at Tweed City Shopping Centre. Passengers wanting to continue travel to Tweed Mall can take select route 601 services or change to other bus services at Tweed City Shopping Centre (routes 600, 603, 605, 606).  

See the news article for more information.

  • Parramatta Rd after Burwood Rd (213722) will be closed.

infoLinks.urlText: Bus changes across Western Sydney from 5 July
infoLinks.content:
From Sunday 5 July, we’ll be making changes to some bus services across Western Sydney. 
  • Route 872 will operate temporarily on an adjusted route due to the closure and replacement of Atchison Street bridge. 
  • Route 872 will not stop along Atchison St and Railway Pde between Victoria Rd and Glenfield Station during the bridge closure. 
  • Allow extra travel time.
  • To find out more, read the news article and visit Bus changes at Transport or New Bus Services for Western Sydney.

infoLinks.urlText: N40 East Hills to City Town Hall bus service changes
infoLinks.content:
From Sunday 8 November, some changes will be made to the N40 East Hills to City Town Hall Nightride bus services to align with the Southwest Metro.
  • Two additional N40 services will run on Sunday nights in each direction to meet the new Southwest Metro operating hours, departing Bankstown at 11.38pm and Town Hall at 11.40pm.
  • There will be minor bus stop changes at Campsie, Belmore and Wiley Park.
For more information about the Southwest Metro opening, visit the Southwest Metro page.

infoLinks.urlText: Station Update - Central
infoLinks.content:
From Sunday to Thursday, between 10pm and 5am, ceiling installation works will take place in the pedestrian tunnel between platforms 4 and 11 and the lower concourse.
 - During this time, the Redfern end stairs on Platforms 4 to 11 will be closed.
 - Customer will need to use the City end of the platform to exit via the Grand Concourse.
 - If you need assistance, ask station staff or call 9379 1777.

infoLinks.urlText: Bus changes across Western Sydney from 5 July
infoLinks.content:

  • Route 872 will operate temporarily on an adjusted route due to the closure and replacement of Atchison Street bridge. 
  • Route 872 will not stop along Atchison St and Railway Pde between Victoria Rd and Glenfield Station during the bridge closure. Allow extra travel time.
  • To find out more, read the news article and visit Bus changes at Transport or New Bus Services for Western Sydney.

infoLinks.urlText: School bus changes during Calderwood Road closure
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 12 October, some school bus services operated by Kiama Coaches and Premier Illawarra will run to changed routes and times due to the planned closure of Calderwood Road, Calderwood.
  • The changes affect students travelling to and from Corpus Christi Catholic High School, St Paul’s Catholic Primary School and Calderwood Christian School.
  • Students may need to catch their bus earlier in the morning and arrive home later in the afternoon.
  • All affected school bus services will use the new bus zone on Calderwood Road for pick-ups and drop-offs, bus stop Calderwood Christian School (2527250).
  • Students and parents should plan ahead and allow extra travel time while the diversion is in place.
  • Trip Planner will be updated two weeks prior to help you plan your journey.
Routes impacted:
  • S490 - Gerringong to Oak Flats & Albion Park Schools via Kiama & Jamberoo
  • S124 - Gipps St af Hothersal St to Calderwood Christian School
  • S125 - Shellharbour Rd opp Barrack Av to Calderwood Christian School
  • S126 - Southern Cross Bvd bf Monkhouse Pde to Calderwood Christian School
  • S127 - Burdekin Dr opp Roper Rd to Calderwood Christian School
  • S128 - Terry St at Wiley St to Calderwood Christian School
  • S129 - Prince Edward Dr at Kanahooka Rd to Albion Park HS via Horsley

infoLinks.urlText: Parramatta bus diversions for Rugby League World Cup game
infoLinks.content:
Sunday 1 November
  • Between approximately 9.50pm to 10.20pm, routes 549, 550, 600, 601 and 606 services will divert while road closures are in place on sections of O’Connell St, Ross St and Victoria Rd for a Rugby League World Cup game at CommBank Stadium.
  • Check signs at stops and walk to nearby alternative stops, see the road closure and transport map and the event page for more details
Closed and alternative stops:
  • Parramatta Leagues Club, O'Connell Street will be closed
    – alternative stop O’Connell Street opp Harold Street (for services towards the Hills, North Rocks, Epping and Macquarie Park)  
  • Parramatta North Public School, Albert St and Our Lady of Mercy College, O'Connell Street will be closed
    – alternative stop O’Connell Street at Fennell Street (for services towards Parramatta Station)  
  • Victoria Rd opp Prince Alfred Square will be closed
    – alternative stop All Saints' Anglican Church, Victoria Rd (for services towards Parramatta Station)  
  • Prince Alfred Square, Victoria Rd will be closed
    – alternative stop O'Connell St opp Harold St (for services towards the Hills, North Rocks, Epping and Macquarie Park)

urlText: Trains run between Blue Mountains Line stations and Blacktown only
content:
Saturday 31 October and Sunday 1 November
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Blue Mountains Line stations and Blacktown only.
  • Use T1 Western Line trains between Blacktown and Central.
  • Trains from Blacktown to Blue Mountains Line stations run 30 minutes later than the normal timetable.
  • Bathurst trains continue to run between Bathurst and Lithgow or Central.

  • If travelling to Lithgow to connect with a NSW TrainLink Regional Coach, call 132 232 before travelling to confirm departure times.

  • Sunday from 2am to 10am, buses replace trains between Olympic Park and Central.
  • T1 Western Line trains run to a changed timetable between Penrith and Olympic Park.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
11T2   Olympic Park, all stations to Ashfield and return
42T7   Olympic Park, Strathfield, Central and return

Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.
subtitle: Trains run between Blue Mountains Line stations and Blacktown only

infoLinks.urlText: Trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern. Buses replace some trains
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 31 October and Sunday 1 November
  • Inner West trains do not run. T1 Western and T2 Leppington trains make extra stops.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Leppington and T1 North Shore Line stations via Granville or Regents Park, stopping at all stations between Ashfield and Central.
  •  T1 Western Line trains make extra stops at all stations between Lidcombe and Ashfield.
  • You will need to change trains if travelling to Museum, St James or Circular Quay.

  • Saturday from 4pm to 1.30am, some trains run between Leppington or Liverpool and Olympic Park.

  • Sunday from 2am to 10am, buses replace trains between Olympic Park and Ashfield. Express buses also run between Olympic Park and Central.
  • Replacement buses do not leave from Lidcombe.

  • Trains run to a changed timetable between:
    - Leppington or Glenfield and Olympic Park
    - Glenfield and the City via the Airport
    - Ashfield and the City, continuing to T1 North Shore Line stations.
  • You may need to change services to continue your journey.

  • Sunday from 8am to 2pm, buses replace trains between Leppington and Glenfield.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
 
Bus routes
Sunday only
11T2    Olympic Park, all stations to Ashfield and return
42T7   Olympic Park, Strathfield, Central and return

infoLinks.urlText: Bus improvements in Kiama and Jamberoo from 20 July
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 20 July, we’re making changes to bus services in Kiama and Jamberoo to improve connectivity and travel times. 
 
The Route 125 service will see 10 additional weekly services added to the bus network between Jamberoo and Kiama on weekdays, including during school holidays. Additionally, students travelling to Jamberoo Public School from Curramore, Jamberoo and Kiama will benefit from a better-timed morning bus service.
 
Changes:
  • Changed timetable and route path for some trips.
  • The 7.35am from Kiama Station will no longer operate via Jamberoo Mountain Road.
Plan your trip and read the news article for more information.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney Olympic Park diversions and additional services for BIGBANG concert
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 31 October
 
From 1am Saturday to 1am Sunday, route 526 buses will divert and miss stops due to road closures in Sydney Olympic Park for the BIGBANG concert at Accor Stadium.
  • From 1am to 4.15pm, and from 11.45pm until 1am, buses will divert via Edwin Flack Avenue, Sarah Durack Avenue and Australia Avenue in both directions.
    • Buses travelling towards Rhodes will use Olympic Park Station, Park St (212712) instead of Park St opp Olympic Park Station (212790).
    • Stops on Dawn Fraser Avenue will also be missed in both directions.
  • From 4.15pm to 11.45pm, buses will divert via Holker Busway, Australia Avenue and Herb Elliot Avenue in both directions.
    • Buses travelling towards Rhodes will use Olympic Park Station, Park St (212712) instead of Park St opp Olympic Park Station (212790).
    • Stops on Dawn Fraser Avenue and Edwin Flack Avenue will also be missed in both directions.
  • Additional route 526 services will also run to Olympic Park from 4.30pm.
  • Extra return services to Strathfield or Rhodes will leave Olympic Park every 6 to 10 minutes from 10.35pm until 12.40am.
  • Allow extra time and check signs at stops for alternate stop locations. Visit the BIGBANG event page for more details.
Missed stops:
  • Olympic Park Station, Dawn Fraser Ave (212792)
  • Park St opp Olympic Park Station (212790)
  • Dawn Fraser Ave opp Olympic Park Station (212791)
  • Dawn Fraser Ave before Edwin Flack Ave (212788)
  • Dawn Fraser Ave after Edwin Flack Ave (212787)

    From 4.15pm to 11.45pm only:
  • Accor Stadium, Edwin Flack Ave (212736)
  • Edwin Flack Ave opp Accor Stadium (212735)

infoLinks.content:
From Monday 20 July, we’re making changes to route S482 morning bus services in Kiama and Jamberoo to improve connectivity and travel times. 
  • Route S482 AM will now service only Jamberoo Public School.

The bus schedules have been coordinated so students can move directly between services, with no waiting time required.
Plan your trip and read the news article for more information.

infoLinks.urlText: Bus changes across Western Sydney from 5 July
infoLinks.content:
From Sunday 5 July, we’ll be making changes to some bus services across Western Sydney. 
  • Transport for NSW is introducing new bus services to connect Penrith, Oran Park, Campbelltown, Liverpool, Mount Druitt and Leppington with local centres, the new Western Sydney International Airport*, and in the future, to the emerging Bradfield City Centre.
  • New routes 772, 790, 825, 840, 845, 849 and 860 will deliver better connections 7 days a week for Western Sydney, linking communities to employment hubs, transport and essential services with frequent, reliable, and sustainable transport.
  • To find out more, read the news article and visit Bus changes at Transport or New Bus Services for Western Sydney.
*Passenger services will commence in October 2026.

infoLinks.urlText: Chisholm school bus changes from 20 July
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 20 July (Term 3), there will be a new afternoon bus route 1337 and changes to route 2763, 2522, 2611 and 1304 services, with three of the routes extending into Chisholm.
 
Operated by CDC Hunter Valley Coaches, students and parents can plan the new school journey on Trip Planner. View the news article for more information.
 
Changes by route:
  • New route 1337 - Maitland High School to Chisholm
    • New afternoon route
  • 2763 - St Aloysius PS to Maitland Grossman HS via Thornton
    • Morning service will extend to Maitland High School and Maitland Grossman School
  • 2522 - Mereweather HS to Bolwarra Heights
    • Afternoon service will now service Sophia Waters and Chisholm
  • 2611 - Chisholm to Mereweather High School
    • Morning service will now start in Sophia Waters
  • 1304 - San Clemente High School to Lakeside
    • To be withdrawn and alternative via route 1323.
